messages:
Zara: posted postmortem for the repeated KV fallback delay. link: https://notion.redwood/pm/kv-fallback-delay-2025
IncidentBot: Postmortem created by Zara. Please attach remediation owners, closure criteria, and add to ACTION tracker.
Ken: Suggest we add explicit closure criteria for each action (owner, PR merged, staging tests passed, tabletop run). Too many items linger without clear accept criteria.
Neha: Agreed. I'll update the runbook template to include a `closure_criteria` section and a small checkbox list that CI can verify.
Sam: Good call. Also proposing a brief tabletop drill to validate runbook steps: simulate eviction + run fallback wrapper, measure p95 delta. Who can own?
Diego: I'll run the tabletop in staging and write a small harness that automates the preflight + fallback + revert. Will output a pass/fail artifact that the CI can consume.
Zara: Owners: runbook template update -> Neha; tabletop harness -> Diego; closure criteria + ACTION ticket -> Zara; rollout notes + comms -> Sam.
Ken: For escalation timing, let's standardize to: ENG-ONCALL page immediately; 2m ack window for APAC, 3m for US/EU; escalate to ENG-SRE if no ack. If fallback is invoked, infra-leads should be paged if error rate >4% for 10m. Include these numbers in the template.
Neha: I'll add a small "oncall quickstart" section for the first 5 minutes: exact commands, what to paste into PagerDuty message, and a short expected side-effects bullet list.
Sam: dropping some diagnostic commands to include in the quickstart (copy/paste):
```
# check collector logs + redis latency
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/kv-collector -c collector --tail=200 | tail -n 50
redis-cli -h cache.prod -p 6379 latency latest
# check fallback controller state
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://control.redwood/api/v1/fallbacks | jq .state
# trigger safe fallback (wrapper should do preflight)
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/fallbacks/trigger -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"mode":"gradual","percent":10}'
```
Diego: wrapper will run preflight promql checks: spare_capacity_pct >= 10, error_rate_1m <= 1.0, p95_latency_1m <= 250ms. It will also produce a json artifact to ACTION tracker.
Zara: I'll create ACTION-9821 and link it to the postmortem. ACTION-9821 will list owners, due dates, and closure criteria. Tentative due dates: runbook template by 2025-01-14, tabletop harness by 2025-01-10, staging validation by 2025-01-12.
Ken: Can we add a recurring "game-day" quarterly event that runs the harness against staging traffic and updates a playbook badge (pass/fail) in the doc? Helps catch drift.
Neha: Good idea. I'll add a CI job that runs the harness on a schedule and updates a badge in the runbook PR. If the badge is failing, auto-assign a playbook review.
Sam: Also add a tiny linters check in the repo that enforces the presence of: owner, action-id, closure_criteria, expected_side_effects. Neha + Diego to coordinate on CI bits.
Diego: will add the harness repo PR and a GH Actions workflow that uploads the artifact to ACTION-9821. Will also add basic tests.
Zara: adding escalation matrix to the ACTION ticket: include regional owners and the 2m/3m ack windows. Will also add "who to CC" for infra-leads and product for high-impact customer incidents.
Ken: please include an explicit note: "DO NOT force global fallback without confirming progressive canary and spare_capacity checks" — add example PagerDuty text to use.
Neha: will include the PD text template and exact `curl` snippet to hit PagerDuty incidents API in the quickstart.
Sam: scheduling a 30m follow-up sync to review PRs and check the harness results next Monday 09:00.
IncidentBot: ACTION-9821 created and linked to the postmortem. Follow-up meeting scheduled for 2025-01-13 09:00 (invite sent). Reminder 24h prior.
Diego: I'll paste the staging run results here after I run the harness. Expecting initial pass/fail and key metrics.
Zara: thanks all, goal is to close ACTION-9821 within two sprints. Please link PRs and artifacts back to the ticket. :thumbsup:
